newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony hits record high on robust earnings.
newsitem.headline: Sony hits record high on robust earnings.

text.p: Shares of Sony Corp surged to an all-time high on Friday, cheered by robust growth in the electronics giant's earnings for the first quarter announced late on Thursday, traders said.
The shares jumped 400 yen to a record high of 12,200 yen by 0049 GMT, making Sony the third largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE).
Its turnover of 1.22 million was the seventh largest on the TSE.
On Thursday, Sony said its first-quarter profits more than doubled, as a weak yen favoured sales of its mainstay electronics products.
Sony announced a group net profit of 34.82 billion yen in the three months to June 30 compared with 17.10 billion yen in the same period a year earlier.
